questiontext.text:
For each statement, choose the method that its form points to. Use the questions in the box above: is it true, is it about a finite number of cases, is each case built from the one before, is it of the form ‘if A, then B’, or does it say that something is impossible?

generalfeedback.text:
Ask the questions in order. A false statement cannot be proved, so test first. A finite list of cases can be checked one by one. A statement about every positive integer whose cases build on each other suggests induction. ‘If A, then B’ suggests a direct proof (or a contradiction). A statement that something is impossible suggests contradiction.
